subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw expose current-session resetSession on after-compaction hooks, and should terminal tool-loop overflow independently auto-rotate sessions without a hook request?
rationale: The first choice creates a durable plugin API contract, while the second changes documented default recovery and session continuity; tests cannot determine the intended product policy.

options.title: Narrow and split
options.body: Keep only the scoped deferred hook API after owner approval, remove automatic overflow resets and unrelated loop-guard changes, and pursue those policies separately.

options.title: Approve the combined policy
options.body: Land the hook API and automatic recovery together only after explicit owner sign-off plus exact-head fresh-install and upgrade behavior proof.

options.title: Pause the API
options.body: Rework or close the branch until a plugin/session owner defines the permanent hook reset contract and supported harness set.

recommendation.title: Narrow and split
recommendation.body: Keep only the scoped deferred hook API after owner approval, remove automatic overflow resets and unrelated loop-guard changes, and pursue those policies separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current-main Codex hook and harness lifecycle history is the closest match for deciding the cross-harness plugin contract.
